title: Agents propose, people approve what matters, results get checked
body: A discount, a CRM update and a refund. Each runs within delegated authority or named approval, and nothing continues until the result checks out.

workflows.title: Discount to confirmed quote
workflows.body: An agent proposes a scoped discount. A separate named manager approves the exact details, tied to the current source and policy. The sample quote changes and is checked before the simulated confirmation email goes out.

workflows.title: CRM update, then acknowledgement
workflows.body: A fixed CRM contact update runs after independent approval. The customer acknowledgement waits until the CRM change is verified. If the source is stale or the result is uncertain, the workflow holds.

workflows.title: Refunds within set limits
workflows.body: Refunds under the policy threshold run within delegated authority. Above it, a person approves the exact refund. Hard-limit violations are blocked. A lost response is reconciled with the provider, not retried as a second refund.

note: These are controlled demonstrations using sample records and private versions of each provider. No real money moves and no customer email is sent.
